results.evidence: LLM = predicts next token; limits: cutoff date, no private data, hallucination. RAG = Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Before answering, system retrieves relevant chunks, adds them to prompt, then LLM generates. Preparation: documents → chunks → embeddings → vector database (done once). Question-time: Retrieve (semantic search) → Augment (add to prompt) → Generate (answer with citations). Benefits: fresh/private data, fewer hallucinations, sources, no retraining. Limitation: answer only as good as retrieved chunks. RAG ≠ fine‑tuning.
